test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In the evening, a person was standing such that his shadow was to his left. In which direction was he facing?
solution:
Given: In the evening, a person was standing such that his shadow was to his left.

As, it is mentioned 'evening', therefore it is sunset time, thus the position of the sun will be in the west direction. Since the shadow is to the left of the person, which is the west direction, therefore the person facing towards the south direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac83c38149397cefa902498622741afd26ace6f9590f9b0bfd5fd916fc9180c1.png] 

Thus, the person for facing in the south direction.

Hence, **"Option 1" **is the correct answer.
